'''Spot-luma lum''' was a drink served at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. Much like the other items for sale at the Glow Dome, the [[Lum/Legends|lum]] was expensive&mdash;costing 15 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a glass.<ref name="WHoSaV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spot-luma lum was first mentioned in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Paul Danner]].<ref name="WHoSaV" />
